Thanks again for the time today — good discovery. Quick recap and the ask so we can lock the next step:

- Primary use case: real-time document summarization + semantic search across internal support docs.
- Peak profile: spiky bursts during business hours (US PST), roughly 120 concurrent requests at 1–2 second latency target for tail P95.
- Desired SLA: sub-2s median, P95 under 3s; retention / audit logs required.

Goal of next meeting:
- Technical deep dive / demo + dedicated capacity sizing session (we'll size GPU pool and alignment on batching/KV cache).
- Invite: your engineering lead + our Solutions Engineer (Priyom) and SRE (Sergio).

Proposed next steps / ask:
1) Please confirm which of these 60–90 minute slots work for you (all times PST):
   - Tue Dec 22 — 9:00–10:30am
   - Tue Dec 22 — 2:00–3:30pm
   - Wed Dec 23 — 11:00am–12:30pm
2) Before the call, can you complete the attached capacity intake (capacity_intake.csv) with sample QPS, typical sequence lengths, and expected concurrency during peak windows? That helps Priyom size the pool and come prepared with kernel/quantization suggestions.
3) If there's anyone else on your side who should be on the sizing discussion (security, compliance, or SRE), please loop them in.

Attachments: capacity_intake.csv (CSV) — light template, mutual_action_plan.docx (MAP) — draft timeline for rollout and checkpoints.

I'll hold the slots for 24 hours — once you confirm I'll send a calendar invite with a link to the demo environment and a short pre-read.
